description: Filter the EAC's certified, under-test, Withdrawn or Decertified Systems, terminated and ESTEP e-poll-book rows by list, MORVS-curated vendor label, testing standard or proposed end-of-life notice flag. Defaults to the certified voting-system list. Returns EAC names, standards, dates and source links. A system named in the EAC's April 2026 notice remains on the certified list while the notice is proposed. Federal certification is voluntary; state law decides use. Never call a system insecure or outdated; use decertified only inside the EAC's own list name. Includes the EAC's exact security statement and the November 2024 EAVS survey label.

eol_notice.description: If supplied, filter for systems named in the EAC April 2026 EOL notice; retirement remains proposed while still certified.

list.description: EAC list: certified, under_test, withdrawn_or_decertified, terminated or epollbooks; defaults to certified.

standard.description: Optional testing standard as listed in the EAC data.

vendor.description: Optional case-insensitive EAC manufacturer or MORVS vendor-label substring.

name: election_voting_systems
title: Find EAC Voting Systems
